mechanism: Adopt the field-standard public CC0 graft floor as-is: thtennant v19 flag set {efficiency, retry_guard, shortcircuit, goalkeep, hudmask} installed into the stock duck/TAAF harness via one cell-12 install() call, banking/transfer OFF and asserted-absent (their triggers are unreachable on this rail: 0 wins in 495 recorded campaign game-runs; 0 clone siblings on 25 unique game_ids). goalkeep+hudmask target LEVELS (stop the carried world model being wiped); shortcircuit targets SCORE (trim no-op actions from the quadratic denominator min(115,(baseline/actions)^2*100)). Engine unchanged (Qwen3.6). One variable.
design: Frozen-fork eval, 25 bundled games offline, n_passes=1, LEVELS-primary per SCREEN_PROTOCOL; install certified from the RUNTIME banner (install() never raises and degrades silently to stock, so an uncertifiable install is INFRA DEATH, never NULL).

instrument_note: The sealed scorer initially returned INFRA DEATH on a PERFECT banner: _read_log never decoded the CLI-2.2.3 JSON log container, so quotes arrived backslash-escaped and the textual flag match could not fire; the 22-check selftest had only plain-text fixtures (internal consistency is not correctness - second instance of the q38-low class). Fix was world-normalisation only (decode JSON-array logs to data payloads), assertions and thresholds byte-untouched, applied BLIND (the scorer died before reading benchmark.json, so the repair could not be steered by an outcome), +3 CLI-JSON regression fixtures negative-controlled; the selftest's hardcoded n_checks=22 was also silently absorbing new checks and is now counted (25).
why_informative: This null retires 'adopt the public conservative graft floor' as a capability route on our rail: with the install runtime-certified and every reachable flag armed, goalkeep - the community's fix for the world-model WIPE defect, and the only flag with a plausible route to SIGNAL - produced zero detectable levels movement against a bar the prereg honestly stated a modest real effect would fail to clear. It also re-confirms, now at n=495 runs, that banking's win-gated exploit is monetizable only after a capability we do not have. What the null does NOT touch: the SCORE endpoint. Descriptively (sealed non-inferential) the arm cut total actions 19-32% at flat levels and outscored its lc-matched baseline by +0.88 - the exact quadratic-denominator signature the 08-17 conversion trace predicted for shortcircuit. The next falsifiable question this row licenses is a SCORE-primary prereg on that denominator, and separately the capture-side memory fix (exp 17: 97.64% of content routes to the hidden channel goalkeep never reads), which this LEVELS-null does not adjudicate because the wipe-fix alone demonstrably was not enough.
